Build the sweet chilli flavour into the filling or dressing before it hits the bread, then taste it. It should taste good on its own before it becomes a sandwich.
Lay out the bread, spread right to the edges and add the wetter ingredients away from the bread where you can — nobody asked for a soggy lunch.
